**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind the closeout to the reviewed implementation commit**

When `1de27ca` is reviewed or promoted, this artifact claims the implementation is commit `24be908`, but that commit is a sibling of `1de27ca`—neither is an ancestor of the other—and this commit itself contains both the implementation and closeout changes. Review or CI evidence following this provenance can therefore validate a different tree. Split the implementation and companion closeout into separate commits and bind the companion to its actual implementation parent.
